2.1.1 is a bug-fix release for Android. It has an Android APK only: nothing changed for macOS, Windows or Linux, so there is no new build for them.

## Android
**Fixed**
- Swiping the app away from the recent apps list now closes it: the music stops and the notification goes. Before, it kept playing with no screen, and opening the app again said it "isn't responding".
- Lyrics appear. The Better Lyrics service asks every app to pass a check first, which the Android app couldn't do, so songs came back without lyrics. It now passes it by itself (rarely, a small box asks for one tap). Romanization and translation work with it.
- Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, Thai and Indic titles and lyrics are drawn properly instead of as empty boxes.
- Typing no longer loses letters. A fast keyboard, a swipe keyboard or a pasted word could arrive with letters missing ("yoasobi tabun" as "yostabun"); deleting and autocorrect are followed too.
- The player notification appears when a song starts playing, not as soon as the app opens.
- Song titles in Quick picks have the screen's width instead of being cut short, and a shelf always comes to rest on a full page.

**Changed**
- The app is drawn in your phone's own font, like your other apps. The font setting is gone on Android.
- Settings fit a phone: what only a PC has is no longer shown (output device, font, window, Discord, proxy, keyboard shortcuts), switches sit at the right of their row, descriptions are shown in full, and the wording names your phone instead of Windows.
- Last.fm's Connect opens the sign-in page in your browser.
- The app stays in portrait.
- Less battery used while playing: the system is told about the player when something changes, not several times a second.

**New**
- The app tells you when a new version is out: a card at the top of Home says so, and a tap downloads the APK in your browser. Open the download to install it. It reads this repository's releases only.

## Installing over 2.1.0
Android will not install this APK over 2.1.0, because the two were signed with different keys: uninstall 2.1.0 first, then install 2.1.1. Your downloaded songs stay in the folder you chose; your sign-in and settings start fresh.

## Known issues
- Android: 64-bit ARM phones only, Android 8 or newer.
- Android: signing in with Google or Spotify needs your own account to be tried on your phone; tell us if it doesn't complete.

Found a bug? [Open an issue](https://github.com/aminuddinihsan20/BitChord-PC-Official/issues).
